scope: Technical eligibility for paper research only
eligible_evaluation: Prospective observations created after policy freeze and model freeze; 2026 and all previous research periods are development evidence only

gates.data_quality: Every evaluated input/label has verified spot-index provenance, timezone, complete required candle windows and an evidence-backed exchange session
gates.reproducibility: Frozen artifact SHA256 and schema match; reload probability and regression maximum absolute difference <= 1e-10
gates.cutoff: Fit and calibration label ends strictly precede model freeze; inputs available no later than forecast creation
gates.sample: At least 1000 prospective outcomes across at least 60 verified trading days per target
gates.calibration: Day-cluster-bootstrap upper 95% confidence bound for equal-width 10-bin multiclass ECE <= 0.05
gates.proper_scores: No worse than frozen prior-frequency baseline on log loss and multiclass Brier; paired day-bootstrap upper 95% bound on excess loss <= 0
gates.interval: Nominal 90%; day-bootstrap 95% coverage interval wholly within [0.85,0.95]
gates.width: Mean point interval width <= frozen baseline width on identical evaluation timestamps
gates.leakage: Temporal perturbation tests pass, preprocessing fit only on training, calibration only on prior calibration period, no revised-model selection on 2026
gates.freshness: Completed genuine candle <=120 seconds old; timestamp <= creation; session open; elapsed horizon ends before verified close
gates.session: Unknown or conflicting schedule evidence blocks recording
gates.multiplicity: All model/target comparisons disclosed; no superiority claim without preregistered family adjustment and dependence-aware paired evaluation

initial_decision: BLOCKED: no prospective outcomes under this newly frozen policy; no retroactive approval
